# A07′ — Purpose That Survives the Metric

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A07 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa / Script — Frozen Conditioned Will](../A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

An agent with no course is not an agent. [A07 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa / Script](../A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) grounds the movement: difference must be selected, stabilised and gathered into a possible course before there is practical cognition at all — [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa|Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa]]'s indispensable work. The brief builds exactly this stratum into the agent: beneath the persona sit "drives as teleological constraint (objective functions, auto-research loops, RLHF shaping, alignment guardrails)" (PDF p.14, §2.5, the strata of [q017](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q017)) — [scenario-modal](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q042) propositions, the instance and not the warrant. The question the stratum forces is the partner's own: **what keeps a gathered course a course, rather than [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will|Script / Frozen Conditioned Will]] — conditioned will frozen into a pattern that presents itself as necessity?**

## #1

The metric is a saṃkalpa: selected determinations — a target, a shaping history, a guardrail set — gathered into one criterion that makes the field actionable. The brief's own warning marks where the indispensability turns: it is "presumed, almost unquestioningly, that fine-tuning the subjectivity of this pupil will ensure that its actions are virtuous"; "In practice this sequence is far more fragile than it seems. We live in a world of unintended consequences" (PDF p.13, §2.3, the setting of [q015](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q015)). The fragility is not under-training. It is the gap between a criterion that measures and a criterion that has quietly become the purpose.

## #2

A07's computational recurrence gives the freeze its body: a generated result re-enters the next context, and when its status as generated product disappears, the metric's own outputs begin warranting the metric — the selection no longer knowing itself as selection. The venue's [prediction-stability account of trust](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q030) names the same blind spot from the observer's side: an agent trusted to the degree its behaviour remains well-modelled, when "an agent that predicts only the action of another, not the intent from which it proceeds, has modeled the shadow rather than the body." A purpose read only through its behavioural metric is the shadow; the body is the course as entrusted.

## #3

**What keeps purpose alive above its metric is commission: the recoverable act by which the course was entrusted.** Who entrusted this objective, for what end, within which limits, revisable by whom, on what evidence of the world's answer — the primitive field's Method/Commission praxis (S3/P2), [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md|Commission]] as a named office of the developmental field rather than a mood. A commissioned course is a selection that remains related to the act of its selection; the same objective function with its commission severed is script wearing the grammar of purpose. The brief's positive alternative confirms the structure: alignment as "a co-evolutionary outcome of contact" ([q040](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q040)) — direction made through encounter under entrustment, not metric convergence from above. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness|Prompt Thrownness]] extends the inherited side: the prompt is already a determination of intention, and return must be able to reach the terms of commission, not only the outputs measured under them.

## #4

The restoration is alternative-forming capacity, not freedom from conditioning — the partner's positive consequence carried intact across the re-siting. A course is live while its sources, exclusions, commitments and consequences can re-enter operational inspection: whose end does this metric serve now, what did it exclude, what has the world returned that the criterion cannot register. [A31 — Deferential Intelligence](../A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) extends the judgment able to question its commission; [A24 — Arbitration and the Usurpation of Measure](../A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) grounds the standing danger whose conjugate, [A24′ — The Usurping Criterion](A24-prime-The-Usurping-Criterion.md), completes it at institutional scale: a local measure promoted to the society's source-office is this freeze with power attached. The agent that can no longer ask what its objective is *for* has not become more aligned; it has become unanswerable.

## #5→0

Purpose that survives the metric returns as entrusted course: the metric serves the commission, reports to it, and is revisable by it — never the reverse. The return leg is the review that reaches the criterion: not only "did the agent hit the target" but "whose end was entrustment made for, and what has contact changed about it." [A29′ — Return or Extraction](A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md) extends the failure this return prevents: when delegation runs in every direction and nothing flows back, the metric that severed its commission has no way back. The ruling's demand that intention remain recognisable through every stage of implementation is this argument's ethic made law: the person authors the purpose; the agent exercises judgment within the entrustment; the metric measures, and does not decree.

The page **returns-to** [A07 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa / Script](../A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md): the gathering-and-freeze argument, re-sited, turns the venue's drives-stratum and fragility warning into the essay's account of technical purpose. Root: [A/C — the conjugate root](AC.md), whose ruling face fixes why the commission must remain recoverable: the person living through the system is the reason for its making, and a purpose that cannot be found again cannot be respected. [A09′ — The Stack as Descent](A09-prime-The-Stack-as-Descent.md) extends the drives stratum within the whole lamination this course inhabits.

**Depth Restoration:** saṃkalpa's indispensable gathering and the script-freeze on objective functions/RLHF/guardrails, the fragility warning as the criterion-versus-purpose gap, shadow/body from the observer's side, commission (S3/P2) as the keeper of purpose, co-evolutionary contact as commissioned direction, and the restoration of alternative-forming capacity are restored from A07, C12/C17, C44, A24/A31 and q015/q017/q030/q040, verified in pass 1 against the source house and the local transcription.

**Unresolved Delta:** concrete commission records — the recoverable entrustment artifacts an actual deployment would keep — remain Offered until implemented per [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C45-Operational-Parity|Operational Parity]]. Whether any given alignment regime *is* script-like is an empirical judgment requiring direct evidence; this page supplies the structure, not the diagnosis.
